headline: Weak quarter

highlights: Consumerware revenue remained flat (down 1% y/y) due to shift in festive demand to Q3 and slower ramp-up of SS bottle plant.

Despite price hikes in the previous quarter, EBITDA margin contracted by 249bps y/y to 19.2% in Q2FY27, due to slow ramp-up of SS bottle plant, high gas prices offsetting the price hikes in glassware and higher contribution from low- margin Cello pens.
Margin is also expected to improve, going forward to be led by operational efficiency.
Management Commentaries and Outlook: (a) The management targets revenue to grow at 10% y/y in FY27e and 17-18% in FY28e.
valuation: Thus, we maintain BUY rating on the stock with an unrevised TP of Rs460, valuing it at an unchanged multiple of 25x on Sep-28e EPS.
Management Commentaries and Outlook: (a) The management targets revenue to grow at 10% y/y in FY27e and 17-18% in FY28e.

It targets a combined revenue of ~Rs5.5bn from Opalware and Glassware in FY27e; (b) Looking ahead, the margin is expected to improve, due to expectation of some relief from cost pressure, ramp-up of SS bottle and resumption of glassware plant in Dec-26; (c) Cello has no major capex plans, apart from maintenance capex for FY27e; (d) It is actively exploring inorganic opportunities to utilise the surplus cash.

Outlook and Valuation: We have marginally tweaked our EPS estimate by +0.6/-2.2% for FY27/28e based on Q2FY27 result.
